tasks.label: Build all C++ files in folder
args: Get-ChildItem -Path '${workspaceFolder}' -Filter *.cpp | Where-Object { $_.Length -gt 0 -and ((Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -match '\bmain\s*\(') } | ForEach-Object { $exe = Join-Path '${workspaceFolder}' ($_.BaseName + '.exe'); $p = Get-Process -Name $_.BaseName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($p) { $p | Stop-Process -Force }; & 'C:/Users/creat/AppData/Local/Microsoft/WinGet/Packages/BrechtSanders.WinLibs.POSIX.UCRT_Microsoft.Winget.Source_8wekyb3d8bbwe/mingw64/bin/g++.exe' $_.FullName -std=c++17 -o $exe }
